title: Thirty Years Is Not Late
style: anthemic rock pop, 104 BPM, defiant male vocal NZ/AU accent, time as asset not enemy, vault opening energy, ENAMOUR theme, building verse to huge chorus, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
You held it for thirty years
Some people call that waiting
I call it protecting
Everything from depreciating
The radio station gave you the room
Brendan mastered the tone
You recorded it professionally
And then left it alone

[CHORUS]
Thirty years is not late
Thirty years is perfect timing
Thirty years is not late
That's thirty years of refining
The world wasn't ready
You weren't ready either
Thirty years is not late
Both ready — together

[VERSE 2]
Suno gave the world the model
ElevenLabs gave it the voice
kits.ai gave it your voice clone
Feb 24 — that's the choice
The technology caught up with you
Not the other way around
Thirty years — they weren't wasted
They were waiting to be found

[BRIDGE]
You don't release when it's done.
You release when it's time.
It's time.

[OUTRO]
Thirty years. Not late. On time. Always was.
